name: Pommes Frites with Garlic, Parmesan & Cajun Remoulade
whyItWorks: Deep-fried thin shoestring potatoes tossed in minced raw garlic, chopped parsley, grated parmesan cheese, and served with spicy cajun remoulade. Raw alliums and deep-fry grease aggressively spark GI spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Garlic & Fat Hazard: Best avoided. If craving fries, request plain fries without garlic, cheese, or dipping remoulade.
